mapper.sql: id, user_id, doc_type, doc_number, front_key, back_key, selfie_key, status, reject_reason, submitted_at, reviewed_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM account_kyc_application WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM account_kyc_application WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_kyc_application WHERE doc_type = #{docType} AND doc_number = #{docNumber} AND user_id <> #{userId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_kyc_application (user_id, doc_type, doc_number, front_key, back_key, selfie_key, submitted_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{docType}, #{docNumber}, '', '', '', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE account_kyc_application SET front_key = #{frontKey}, back_key = #{backKey}, selfie_key = #{selfieKey} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE account_kyc_application SET status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reject_reason = #{reason}, reviewed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
